summary.text: Joe Alexander Jr. is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 29 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; he assumed his current seat in December 2022.
He works in the hospitality industry and holds degrees from Saint Anselm College and the University of New Hampshire.

paragraphs.text: Joe Alexander Jr. earned a bachelor's degree in politics from Saint Anselm College in 2017 and a master's of public policy in 2019 from the Carsey School of Public Policy at the University of New Hampshire.
His career experience includes working in the hospitality industry.
Ballotpedia lists Alexander's tenure in the New Hampshire House as beginning in 2018, and he assumed his current seat representing Hillsborough 29 on December 7, 2022.
He was assigned to the House Judiciary Committee in the 2019-2020, 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.
